This is a superb apartment located just a short walk from Clapham Junction, available to rent 15th October.

The property benefits from a decent sized reception room, a large eat in kitchen-diner, two double bedrooms, separate cloakroom/hallway and lots of storage space.

Both bedrooms have space for a desk, and one has a large built-in wardrobe.

  • Two double bedrooms
  • Double glazed throughout
  • Gas central heating
  • Eat in kitchen diner
  • Ample storage space throughout
  • Excellent condition throughout
  • Lots of natural light
Video tour available on youtube link below.

Clapham Junction is 7 minute walk, fast frequent mainline train services to Waterloo, Victoria, Gatwick Airport and the South. Within 10 min walking distance of the shops (large Asda, Lidl, Waitrose, M&S) also bars and restaurants on Northcote Road and Battersea High Street. Battersea Park, Clapham Common and the Thames are all close by. 

Property comes as fully furnished. the furniture and appliances includes:
● fridge-freezer
● washer-dryer
● electric oven-hob
